Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Notes: CAIQ intake call (21 Apr) — action items and evidence plan

Hi Claire / team —

Thanks for the call today. Below are succinct notes and the action register we discussed. If I missed anything, flag edits and I’ll update the shared Drive.

Summary (45m):
- Scope agreed: full CAIQ for Redwood hosted API + optional dedicated deployment for Prod (customer-requested).
- Primary areas to document: access control, logging/retention, encryption (in transit & at rest), incident response, and vendor management.
- Data residency: Redwood offers region-specific deployments; Jonas to provide the current EU region options and timelines.
- Evidence handoff: shared Drive preferred. Redwood will upload sample artifacts and redacted logs to the folder.

Action items:
1) Mateo — upload baseline CAIQ answers (draft) and architecture diagram to Drive by EOD Thu (21 Apr). Attachment: caiq-sample-answers.xlsx.
2) Jonas — provide a short note on EU region availability and data residency controls by Mon 26 Apr.
3) Marissa — prepare SOC 2 scope summary and sample control descriptions; include pointer to SOC 2 report redaction policy by Mon 26 Apr.
4) Procurement (James) — confirm preferred evidence delivery process and any additional contractual security terms to include in the mutual action plan by Fri 23 Apr.
5) Claire — share any high-priority CAIQ questions you want us to mark for early completion.

Notes / Q&A highlights:
- Claire asked about sample logs: we can provide exports (kibana json snippets) and sample retention windows; full raw logs require a scoped export which we can run as part of the engagement.
- Encryption at rest: customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM are supported in Private deployments; hosted uses envelope encryption with customer KMS integration on enterprise plans.
- Incident response: Redwood will share a redacted incident timeline as a sample; operational runbooks are provided under NDA.

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-architecture-diagram.pdf (v1), caiq-sample-answers.xlsx (draft). I will upload a small kibana snippet (kibana-log-sample.txt) as an example.

Next meeting: tentative follow-up week of Apr 26 — will coordinate once action items complete.

Thanks,
Mateo
